लुड् r. 1st cl. (लोडति) To agitate, to stir, to churn. r. 1st and 6th cls.
(लोडति लुडति)
 1. To be in connection or contact with anything,
to join, to adhere to, to rest in or on, &c.
 2. To embrace. r. 6th
cl. (लुडति) To cover, to conceal.
 2. To adhere. (इ) लुडि r. 10th cl.
(लुण्डयति)
 1. To be agitated.
 2. To plunder.
